2. VPA cannot be successfully automated through algorithmic software because programs lack subjectivity and canno
3. The financial market behaves like a massive supertanker possessing immense momentum; it cannot stop or turn in
4. Just as a spill requires a second pass to fully absorb liquid after an initial wipe, the market undergoes a pr
5. Traders must never enter a position immediately upon seeing a single reversal candle or volume anomaly because
6. Absolute volume numbers are meaningless in VPA; traders must strictly evaluate whether a volume bar is low, av
7. Bilateral counterparty exposure demands rigorous collateralization.
8. Always distinguish gross terminal payoff from net trading profit.
